buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Two works costing not less than 11.00 lakh Each OR One work costing not less than 22.00 Lakh OR Averag e Annual turn over for last two consecutive years shall not be less than 50.00 Lakh Registered Office of the service provider must be located in the state of Rajasthan. Documentary evidence to be submitted. The firm should have registered in the name of firm in the state of Rajasthan The firm should have been enlisted with MES in appropriate class as in indicated in NIT. 1. The Contractor shall strictly adhere to all applicable statutory rules, labour laws, and regulatory directives. This includes compliance with Direct ive No 07/2025 issued by E-in-C's Branch, Integrated HQ of MoD (Army). 2. Wage Disbursal and Banking Norms 2.1 The Contractor shall pay full monthly wages via direct electro nic bank transfer to individual employee salary accounts. 2.2 All salary accounts must be single-holder accounts registered under the individual worker's name. The Contractor is explicitly prohibite d from opening or maintaining joint accounts with deployed personnel. Setting up bank accounts or documentation in bulk without physic al presence and informed consent of workers is prohibited. 2.3 Full compliance with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) master directives on Know Your Customer (KYC) is mandatory. ATM cards, pass books, and credential documentation must be delivered directly to the account holder by the bank. The Contractor shall not retain physical or digital possession of any worker's banking tools or credentials. 3. Timelines, Deductions, and Verifications 3.1 Deployed personnel must receive monthly salaries latest by t he 7th day of the succeeding calendar month. Salary payments must remain completely independent of the status of the Contractor’s Running Account (RAR) claims. 3.2 No wage deductions are permitted except statutory obligatio ns like EPF, ESIC, and TDS allowed by law. Taking back or demanding an y portion of wages in cash or kind from a worker constitutes a materi

al breach. 3.3 The Contractor shall ensure that no worker face coercion, penalties, or threats for cooperating with verification processes. The P rincipal Employer reserves an absolute right to directly interact with de ployed workers to verify wage receipts. 4. Documentation for Bill Processing (RAR / Final Bills) 4.1 No RAR or Final Bill payments will be processed by the Garris on Engineer (GE) Jaisalmer without the following validation documents : 4.2 Consolidated monthly attendance sheets bearing the distinct signatures or biometric records of each deployed worker. 4.3 Official bank statements confirming successful individual electronic fund transfers to each worker's account. 4.4 Corroborating bank statement pages or passbook copies from the individual outsourced workers. 4.5 Individualized Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) electronic challans and official statements. 4.6 Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) individual monthly statements and contribution proofs. 4.7 Individual written confirmations signed by each deployed wor ker affirming receipt of full statutory wages. 4.8 The Principal Employer reserves the right to cross-check contractor bank statements against worker passbooks or verified re cords directly with banking institutions. 5. Material Breach, Penalties, and Contract Termination: - Upon establishment of any wage fraud, extortion, or non-compliance wit h banking and labour norms, the Department holds the right to:- 5.1 Forfeit the Performance Security deposit in its entirety. 5.2 Withhold, freeze, or recover any pending or future payments due to the Contractor. 5.3 Terminate the Contract with immediate effect at the sole risk and cost of the Contractor. 5.4 Recommend and initiate formal blacklisting proceedings on t
he Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and other public portals. 5.5 Forward the matter to the State Government Labour Co mmissioner or relevant law enforcement authorities for prosecution. .
